reviews.title: Amazing cables
reviews.comment: They come with multiple cable combs for different styles, are easy to use, work well, and look great. In the photo I put, you can especially tell the difference on the GPU cable.

reviews.title: Good cables, good price.
reviews.comment: Sleek cables. Makes awful PSU cables a non-issue. A bit finicky to get the cable combs on, but otherwise a great aesthetic upgrade for an otherwise clean build. They feel sturdy and are a great length for any PC. I wish they were cheaper.
reviews.author: Daniel Early

reviews.title: Super quality
reviews.comment: Awesome! Worth double the price! Secure connections, high quality and perfect size for completing complex computer build where more length was required! And they look great too! Bought another set just to have on hand!
reviews.author: TechAge

reviews.title: Good fit and finish, really clean white builds
reviews.comment: Bright white, not too stiff. They're super long so it should get where it needs to go when extending the original 24pin cable. The combs clean up the look and are easy to apply but fit tightly once installed. For me it was so well made it practically disappears in plain sight just how I wanted it. Look closely to find it in the video.
reviews.author: C. Jackson

reviews.title: Extensions that enhance the look of any PC Built
reviews.comment: These extensions for power supplies with sleeves are very neat. This is the first time I've bought a product like this; I'd always seen them in reviews or in pre-built PC gaming systems. I always thought they were extremely expensive for what they offered, based on cable mod prices, of course. Until one day I decided to go for it, since I had just built my second gaming PC, and honestly, it's worth it if you care about aesthetics. If you don't care about aesthetics at all, I don't recommend it, since it doesn't add any functionality unless your goal is to extend your PSU cables. I think these particular extensions are reasonably priced. I would summarize this review as follows: Quality They look OK in terms of quality. They don't look like a premium product, but I didn't expect that for the price. Adjustability The cable combs come in a separate bag, which means you have to attach them to the cables, and it's quite a tedious task. But I also understand that depending on your build, you'll need to place them in a different position or orientation. Perhaps an alternative I'd like to see is for the combs to be double-sided, so it wouldn't matter which way they were placed. If you have a small case like mine, it can be a bit challenging to fit the extensions in, but with a little patience, you can do it. The extensions are not rigid, which is important when fitting them in, as it allows you to bend them without any problems. Aesthetics I believe they enhance the aesthetics, making your build look cleaner and more organized. For that reason alone, it's worth it to me. I'm not giving them 5 stars, just because the installation process was so tedious overall. Even though I enjoy the end result.
reviews.author: Jose C.
